scope: Public operational HRS benchmark recheck for an IJHE evidence package
purpose: Record real-station sources that can support face validity or a data request without being misclassified as synchronized full-loop validation.

preferred_channels: SAE J2601 protocol and initial-condition metadata
eligibility_boundary.required_rights: explicit public reuse or written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: Hydrogen Refueling Station Capacity Dataset for California
candidates.license: No explicit repository license field observed; reuse permission unresolved
candidates.finding: The public repository contains real California station capacity/availability indicator files, but no synchronized vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature or mass-flow rows, protocol metadata or explicit reuse license.
candidates.use: Aggregate demand and capacity face-validity context plus a data-request lead; do not use as a full-loop holdout, calibration source or redistributable dataset until rights are clarified.

candidates.title: Data-Driven Intelligent Analysis System for Monitoring and Anomaly Detection in Hydrogen Refueling Station
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the article; raw station logs are not released with the public record

observed_scope.facility: BAM demonstration hydrogen refueling station, Germany

candidates.finding: The article reports field deployment and validation of a safety-monitoring platform, but the public data-availability statement does not provide a downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logger archive with channel, calibration and reuse metadata.
candidates.use: Independent face-validity and architecture context plus a high-priority author data request; not a full-loop holdout until raw data and rights are received and frozen before outcome access.

candidates.title: Multi-year energy performance data for an electrolysis-based hydrogen refueling station
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the article version; raw station logs are not released by the article
candidates.finding: The open article describes real operation and the acquisition architecture, but publishes KPI tables/figures rather than a downloadable synchronized vehicle-pressure, temperature and mass-flow logger archive.
candidates.use: Independent face-validity benchmark and high-priority request for de-identified event-level exports; not a full-loop holdout until the raw archive, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and reuse permission are received and frozen before outcome access.

candidates.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
candidates.license: Elsevier article record is not open access; the underlying operator logs are not distributed as a rights-cleared raw archive

observed_scope.facility: Cal State LA Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility, California, USA
reported_scenarios: back-to-back fueling with less than five minutes between fills

candidates.finding: The article describes a valuable real-station operating campaign and calls the measurements a comprehensive dataset, but the public record exposes the paper rather than a downloadable synchronized station, dispenser and vehicle logger archive.
candidates.use: Independent operating-context citation and high-priority author/data-custodian request; not a full-loop holdout until de-identified event-level files, channel definitions, calibration metadata and reuse permission are received and frozen before outcome access.

candidates.title: Performance of a hydrogen refueling station in the early years of commercial fuel cell vehicle deployment
candidates.license: Article and supplementary chart artifact are publicly reachable; raw operator logs are not released

observed_scope.facility: University of California, Irvine NFCRC HRS
observed_scope.reported_period: first five years of FCEV commercialization

candidates.finding: The public article and supplementary material provide aggregate operational charts and field context, not synchronized pressure-temperature-mass-flow rows for individual fills.
candidates.use: Independent operating-range and reliability context; request de-identified event-level logger data before treating the source as validation.

candidates.title: California Air Resources Board Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study Report
candidates.license: Public agency report; no raw logger reuse licence or raw archive is provided with the report
candidates.finding: The public report states that some stations did not supply dispenser data logs and that missing logs caused tests to be marked undetermined. It contains reported test results and plotted examples, but no downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure-temperature-mass-flow row archive.
candidates.use: Independent field-operation and protocol-context citation only; request a de-identified raw log export and written reuse terms before considering any case for a frozen full-loop holdout.

candidates.title: Next Generation Hydrogen Station Composite Data Products: Retail Stations
candidates.license: Public composite products; partner raw data are not exposed
candidates.finding: The public NREL products are aggregate composite statistics and do not expose row-level synchronized vehicle-side pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces.
candidates.use: Population-level face-validity checks and operating-context citation only; cannot close the full-loop gate.

candidates.title: European H2-Stations export API v2
candidates.finding: The API provides station layout and operational signals but not a synchronized vehicle-fueling pressure-temperature-mass-flow trace.
candidates.use: Station inventory and availability context only; not an experimental validation set.

candidates.title: Supplementary Material for: Modelling and operation strategy approaches for on-site Hydrogen Refuelling Stations
candidates.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for the supplementary article artifact

observed_scope.publisher: Agencia Estatal Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas / Digital.CSIC
contents: one-day compressor and energy simulation plots

candidates.finding: The public supplementary artifact belongs to a modelling study and contains simulation plots and strategy descriptions, not measured synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow rows.
candidates.use: Retain as a model-comparison and protocol-context citation only; it cannot be promoted to an external physical holdout or used to tune the production model.

next_action: Request a de-identified synchronized logger export and written reuse terms from Cal State LA HRFF, UCI NFCRC, NREL/NLR HITRF, CARB/HyStEP, JRC GasTeF, FCH2RAIL or an HRS operator; freeze the model, inclusion criteria and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.
claim_boundary: This record strengthens source accounting and face-validity context. It adds no full-loop validation result and does not permit the IJHE/full-objective completion gate to pass.
